epic.title: Customer checkout and payment
epic.problem_statement: Customers can fill a cart but cannot complete a purchase; there is no flow that reserves inventory, authorizes payment, and confirms an order atomically, so abandoned carts and oversells both occur.
epic.why_now: MVP launch requires a working revenue path before any marketing spend.

tier_signals.evidence_quote: authorize payment and confirm an order

stories.title: Customer completes checkout happy path

card.i_want: to submit my cart and pay

stories.context: Customer has a non-empty cart and a valid address; checkout coordinates inventory, payment and order.

given: a cart with one in-stock item
a cart with one in-stock item
acceptance_criteria.when: the PSP rejects the payment authorization

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: Idempotent resubmit of the same checkout
given: a checkout already completed for an idempotency key
acceptance_criteria.when: the same checkout request is replayed with the same key

pii_fields.justification: shipping address and name are customer PII.

audit_events.justification: money movement requires an audit trail of authorize/confirm.

idempotency.justification: payment submit must be replay-safe across retries.

reversibility.justification: inventory reservation must be released on payment failure.

authn_authz.justification: only the authenticated cart owner may check out.

regulatory.justification: MVP uses a mock PSP; no card data is stored.

tipping_off.justification: no AML/sanctions messaging in this consumer flow.
